page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a centred running head above it. Printed line numbers (5, 10, 15 ...) stand in the left margin and are line-count markers, not notes, so they are not transcribed. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot right.

main_text.l: III. Hieroglyphica inanimata sic habent.
1. Lux est nota hieroglyphica maiestatis Dei. 1.Iohan.1.
v.6. symbolum veritatis,Iohan.3.v.20.21. imago omnium
fidelium, Matth.5.v.14. denique prosperitatis, pacis, læti-
tiæ, consolationis, & omnino status felicis, Iob.18.ver.5.6.
2. Ignis est hieroglyphicum maiestatis Dei, Exod.3. v.2.
Num.16.v.35.2.Petr.3.v.7. item iræ ipsius omnia consumé-
tis, Deut.4.v.23.24.c.9.v.3.Hebr.12.v.28.29. Porrò est ima-
go Christi, Malach.3.v.2.Apoc.1.v.15.c.2.v.18.c.19.v.12. Spiri-
tus sancti, Matth.3.v.11. verbi Dei, Ierem.5.v.14.& c.23. v.19.
Luc.12.v.49. ecclesiæ, Obad.verf.18. doctrinæ falsæ, Apoc.9.
v.17.18. denique linguæ malæ, Prou.16.v.27. Iacob.3.v.5.6.
3. Sol est hieroglyphica imago Christi, Malach.4.verf.2.
gratiæ Dei, Psal.84.v.12.Esa.60.v.19.20. ecclesiæ catholi-
cæ, Cantic.6.v.7. doctrinæ euangelij, Apoc.8.verf.12.&
c.9. v.2. gloriæ & prosperitatis, Ierem.15.v.9. Amos.8.v.9. gloriæ
vitæ æternæ, Matth.17.v.2.c.13.v.43.
4. Luna est imago ecclesiæ. Cantic.6.v.7. Apoc.12.
5. Stellæ sunt hieroglyphicum gloriæ futuræ in alterâ
vitâ, 1.Cor.15.v.40.41.42. Dan.12.v.3. rectorum reip. Dan.8.
v.10. doctorum ecclesiæ, Apoc.1.2.3.& c.8.v.10.11.c.9.verf.1.
Nominatim stella matutina est imago mystica Christi,
Apoc.22.v.16.c.2.v.28. & stellæ erraticæ sunt imago seducto-
rum, Iudæ v.13. denique Phosphorus seu Lucifer, est symbo-
lum doctrinæ euangelij, 2.Petr.1.v.19. & excellentiæ, quâ
quis est prædítus[?], Esa.14.v.12.
6. Aqua est hieroglyphicum Spiritus sancti, eiusq; be-
neficia nobis repræsentat, Esa.12.v.3.c.55.v.1. Ierem.2.v.13.
c.22.v.17. item euangelii, Ezech.47. Zach.14.v.8. sanguinis
Christi, Eph.5.v.26. Hebr.10.v.22.1.Iohan.5.v.6.8. calamita-
tum, 1.Sam.22.v.17. Psal.32.v.6.c.66.v.12.c.69.v.2. denique
numerosæ multitudinis hominum, Ierem.47.v.2. Apoc.17.

page.notes: Printed line numbers 5 to 35 in the left margin omitted as line-count markers. "prædítus" is uncertain; the word may be prædictus or prædītus. Printed "Oo 5" and "7.Ma-" read as signature and catchword. No marginal notes on this page.
